title: New Tight Bounds on the Local Leakage Resilience of the Additive (n, n)-Threshold Scheme Determined by the Eigenvalues of Circulant Matrices
abstract: Recently, Benhamouda et al. [1] formulate leakage from the n shares (X 1 , X 2 ,. .. , X n) of a (t, n)-threshold scheme as Y = (Y 1 , Y 2 ,. .. , Y n), where Y j = τ j (X j), j = 1, 2,. .. , n and τ j , j = 1, 2,. .. , n are deterministic functions with the range {0, 1,. .. , L-1} and evaluate the maximum V * n of the total variational distance between the conditional distributions P Y |S (• |s) and P Y |S (• |s), where the maximum is taken with respect to s, s and τ j , j = 1, 2,. .. , n. In this paper, we propose a new method to evaluate V * n more precisely than the existing methods for the (n, n)-threshold scheme over a finite field F p. For the case of L = 2, we show that V * n converges to zero oforder O((p sin π 2p)-n). We also characterize the class of leakage functions that attain V * n. For the case of L ≥ 3, we succeed in obtaining an upper bound of V * n by using the theory of majorization. The order of the obtained upper bound is smaller than the upper bound in [1] and is proved to be tigh t under a certain assumption.
